residual_risks: Pool initialization is intentionally racy: simultaneous first access can construct multiple unopened ConnectionPool instances, while only one is retained in the alias registry. The code does not close the losing instance; verify with the pinned psycopg-pool version whether unopened instances retain resources or worker threads.
testing_gaps: Add a concurrent first-use lifecycle test for one alias, checking that all wrappers use the winning pool and that discarded unopened pool instances do not leave worker threads or other resources behind.
